name: Wyoming

windshield.strip: nonreflective, not red/yellow/amber, only along the top, not below the AS-1 line or more than 5 in. from the top, whichever is closer to the top

frontSide.note: film + glass combined; nonreflective; luminous reflectance max 20%

backSide.note: film + glass combined; nonreflective; max 20% reflectance; left and right outside mirrors required

rear.note: film + glass combined; left and right outside mirrors required

backSide.note: requirements do not apply to windows behind the driver of trucks, buses, motor homes, ambulances, limousines and multipurpose passenger vehicles

tint.measuredHow: film + glass combined ('total light transmission through both the sunscreening device and glazing')
tint.dualMirrors: One left and one right outside rear-view mirror required if any film is added to windows behind the operator
tint.certificateOrSticker: Medical certificate issued by the WYDOT director must be in the vehicle

medicalExemption.text: Vehicle operated by or regularly transporting a person with a light-sensitive medical condition may have all windows down to 25% (windshield 70% except top 5 in./AS-1). Requires a certificate from the WYDOT director, issued on a signed statement from a licensed physician or optometrist; valid while the condition persists or until the vehicle is sold; kept in the vehicle.

penalty.text: Misdemeanor under the general traffic penalty: fine up to $200 first conviction, $300 second within one year, $500 and/or 6 months third within one year

quotes: shall be a nonreflective type and have total light transmission through both the sunscreening device and glazing of not less than twenty-eight percent (28%)
No sunscreening device or tinting film may be applied or affixed to any window of a motor vehicle that has a luminous reflectance of light exceeding twenty percent (20%).
may not extend downward beyond the AS-1 line or more than five (5) inches from the top of the windshield, whichever is closer to the top
shall not apply to windows behind the driver of trucks, buses, motor homes, ambulances, limousines and multipurpose passenger vehicles
reduce the transmission of light into the vehicle to levels not less than twenty-five percent (25%)

helmet.conditions: Minors (under 18) operating or riding a motorcycle on public roads (not mopeds or enclosed cabs)

handheldPhone.fineText: Texting ban only (dialing allowed); misdemeanor, fine up to $75

studdedTires.season: No seasonal limit in statute; studded pneumatic tires must be approved by the superintendent

radarDetector.note: No state ban found in Title 31; commercial vehicles over 10,001 lb banned federally (49 CFR 392.71)

openQuestions: Section amendment history not printed in the Title 31 PDF; lastAmended unknown
Primary enforcement of texting ban assumed (no secondary clause)
Underglow and lift rules not located
